title: Professional Email Seat Price Schedule
content:
Seat prices for every Professional Email product, in US dollars per seat per month, as the billing desk quotes them.

| Product | Annual term paid up front | Annual term billed monthly | Month-to-month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 1.99 | 0.00 (not offered) | 2.49 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 3.99 | 0.00 (not offered) | 4.99 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 5.99 | 0.00 (not offered) | 7.49 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 6.00 | 6.30 | 7.20 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 12.50 | 13.13 | 15.00 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 22.00 | 23.10 | 26.40 |

## Billing plans and terms

| Product family | Billing plans offered | Terms a subscription can renew into |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter, Plus and Pro | annual prepaid; monthly | annual prepaid; monthly |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Standard and Premium | annual prepaid; annual billed monthly; monthly | annual prepaid; annual billed monthly; monthly |

- **Multi-year terms:** not offered on any Professional Email product.
- **Price protection:** on every product the seat price is fixed for the whole annual term.
- **Account-tier discount:** the account tier's email discount percentage applies to the seat price of Harborline Mail Starter, Plus and Pro; it does not apply to any Microsoft 365 Business product.
- **Rounding:** on every product each computed email amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## Reading the schedule

- A 0.00 entry in the annual-billed-monthly column means that plan is not offered for that product; it is not a free plan.
- All prices are per seat per month, whichever plan is chosen.
- Example (hypothetical lookup): an agent asked for the month-to-month price of Microsoft 365 Business Standard reads 15.00 USD per seat per month from the table; the annual-billed-monthly price of the same product is 13.13.
